_comment: The 12 demo emails. Ground truth from the seed script; 'expected' is what a correct triage produces and is used by the test, not by the agent.

messages.subject: Re: Kitchen quote — revised numbers attached
messages.body: Hung, took another look after our call. Revised the cabinet line down but the electrical went up once I saw the panel. Net is about $1,400 over the original. Can you confirm by Monday so I can hold the installer slot?

messages.subject: Interview availability — next week
messages.body: We'd like to schedule the next conversation. Are you available Tuesday or Wednesday afternoon? Let me know what works and I'll send an invite.

messages.subject: Your prescription is ready for pickup
messages.body: Ready at the pharmacy counter. We hold prescriptions for 10 days.

messages.subject: Re: Contract review — any update?
messages.body: Following up on the draft I sent over two weeks ago. Just want to make sure it didn't get lost. No rush if you're still reviewing.

messages.subject: Your monthly statement is ready
messages.body: Your September statement is now available in online banking. No action is needed.

messages.subject: Weekly digest: 12 stories we're reading
messages.body: This week: the state of small models, a new take on retrieval, and why your team's standup is broken. Plus nine more.

messages.subject: 40% off everything — this weekend only
messages.body: Our biggest sale of the season ends Sunday at midnight. Shop now before it's gone.

messages.subject: Order shipped — arriving Saturday
messages.body: Your order is on the way and should arrive Saturday. Tracking is available in your account.

messages.subject: Re: Saturday plans
messages.body: I think we said we'd decide today. Are we still doing the beach thing with the kids or pushing it to Sunday?

messages.subject: Security alert: new sign-in
messages.body: A new sign-in to your account from a Windows device. If this was you, no action is needed.

messages.subject: Reminder: your appointment is Thursday at 2pm
messages.body: This is a reminder of your appointment Thursday at 2:00pm. Reply CANCEL to cancel.

messages.subject: The state of AI agents — September issue
messages.body: Inside: what changed in tool use this quarter, the quiet rise of voice surfaces, and three teams shipping agents into production.
